title: Issue #4199 daemon authority test determinism
intent: Waiting on the host verification lease to run the fixed gwt lib suite in the Linux container
progress_summary: Root-caused and fixed. Reproduced both reported CI panics byte-identically on develop HEAD in a Linux container by starving only the 250 ms ISSUE_MONITOR_PREFS_TIMEOUT budget (server.rs:13288 !recovery_blocked, and server.rs:13129 Err(Rejected) vs Err(RecoveryBlocked)) - no diff, no PR branch, so this is a load-sensitive fixture, not a develop regression. Contract answer: RecoveryBlocked is correct; Rejected was reachable only because the fixture's own authority load lost its budget and returned recovery_blocked:false with no lease, letting the worker take authority for itself. Fix pins the hang-guard budget in both tests, asserts the overlap premise (lease held), and adds authority_owning_worker_rejects_a_malformed_control to pin the discriminator. All three pass 5/5 under the same starvation. One iteration needed: the new test collided with two sibling tests over a shared project dir, now isolated with ScopedGwtHome. Three other failures in the container run (verification_record x2, work_event_settlement_stop_check) are chmod-000 fixtures defeated by running as root in the container - unrelated to this change.
